prompts.image2d: Use case: style-transfer. Create a TWO-DIMENSIONAL HAND-DRAWN character turnaround from image 1, not a CG image or filtered photograph. Image 1 is authoritative for this exact character's identity, face, mature age direction, proportions, pose, costume, colors, accessories, limb count and all three view details. Image 2 is ONLY a drawing-style reference: refined controlled dark ink linework, subtle line weight, restrained cel color blocks, soft illustrated volume and fine faint paper texture. Do not copy bull identity horns or clothes from image 2. Preserve the original species and existing degree of anthropomorphism, not a redesign. Landscape 3:2 sheet: left full front, center full side, right full back, same scale and baseline, ample margins including full antennae/antlers/wing tips/feet. Warm pale beige paper backdrop with subtle drawn contact shadow. Crisp detailed line-art drawn fur/feathers and fabric folds, clearly non-photoreal and non-3D. No labels text watermark panels scenery extra people. Gray donkey freight driver and porter, very long ears, short upright dark mane, pale broad muzzle, thick adult build. Red cream small-check short-sleeved shirt, charcoal bib overalls, brown boots, waist keys and gloves tucked at hip. Thin tufted donkey tail. NO reflective vest or yellow courier clothes.
prompts.image3d: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied character turnaround. Image 1 is the edit target, authoritative for existing identity, face, species, palette and clothes except explicitly requested changes. Image 2 only anchors high-end feature-film CGI material quality and soft lighting; do not inherit dragon features or royal clothes. ONE landscape 3:2 three-view sheet: front left, side center, rear right. Consistent same character full body, all extremities visible, neutral beige studio backdrop and contact shadows. Preserve crisp fur/fabric details, physically based materials, natural subdued highlights. No text labels logos watermark. Redesign this donkey to be clearly distinct from a tall horse courier, especially costume and silhouette. Retain gray donkey identity, but emphasize very long broad ears with darker edges, short upright bristly mane without horse forelock, broad pale donkey muzzle, slightly older face, stocky broad-shouldered torso and shorter sturdier leg proportions. Replace the ENTIRE mustard reflective vest and dark cargo uniform outfit: use a faded brick-red and cream small-check short-sleeved button shirt, plain off-white undershirt, charcoal-gray canvas bib overalls with broad straps, ordinary brown scuffed work boots, one pair of worn handling gloves tucked into a hip pocket and truck keys at waist. Hands rest naturally at sides. Retain a thin donkey tail ending in a short dark tuft. No reflective vest, no yellow clothing, no helmet, no delivery backpack. A practical experienced freight driver and porter, modest believable clothes; dignified not comic.
